# Issuu
> Issuu is a digital publishing platform for turning PDFs into interactive flipbooks, articles, social assets, and sellable digital content.

Issuu helps publishers, marketers, designers, and businesses distribute documents online with tools for reading, embedding, analytics, sharing, and monetization.

## Core Platform
- [Issuu Home](https://issuu.com/): Main entry point for Issuu’s digital publishing platform and product overview.
- [Features](https://issuu.com/features): Overview of Issuu’s publishing, distribution, engagement, and monetization feature set.
- [Read](https://issuu.com/categories): Browse publications across categories available to read on Issuu.
- [Pricing](https://issuu.com/pricing): Plans and feature tiers for individuals, teams, and businesses using Issuu.
- [Sign Up](https://issuu.com/signup): Account creation page for starting with Issuu publishing tools.
- [Login](https://issuu.com/login): Sign-in page for accessing Issuu accounts and published content.

## Publishing Features
- [Flipbooks](https://issuu.com/features/flipbooks): Convert PDFs into interactive, page-turning digital publications for web and mobile viewing.
- [Articles](https://issuu.com/features/articles): Repurpose publication content into mobile-friendly article formats for broader distribution.
- [Social Posts](https://issuu.com/features/social-posts): Create social media assets from publication pages for promotional sharing.
- [GIFs](https://issuu.com/features/gifs): Generate animated GIF previews from documents for marketing and engagement.
- [Fullscreen Sharing](https://issuu.com/features/fullscreen-sharing): Present publications in an immersive fullscreen reading experience.
- [Add Links](https://issuu.com/features/add-links): Insert clickable links into publications for navigation, commerce, or lead generation.
- [Video](https://issuu.com/features/video): Embed video into digital publications to create richer interactive reading experiences.

## Distribution & Embedding
- [Embed](https://issuu.com/features/embed): Embed Issuu publications on websites without custom development.
- [QR Codes](https://issuu.com/features/qr-codes): Generate QR codes that link directly to digital content for offline-to-online sharing.
- [Share Anywhere](https://issuu.com/features/share): Share publications across channels with hosted Issuu reading experiences.
- [Web-ready Content](https://issuu.com/features): Central feature hub for distributing content across web, social, and email.
- [Read Categories](https://issuu.com/categories): Discovery surface for publicly available content organized by topic.

## Analytics & Monetization
- [Digital Sales](https://issuu.com/features/digital-sales): Sell digital publications directly to readers through Issuu’s monetization tools.
- [Statistics](https://issuu.com/features/statistics): Track readership, engagement, and content performance with built-in analytics.
- [Add Links](https://issuu.com/features/add-links): Use clickable links to drive conversions, product discovery, and campaign traffic.
- [Articles](https://issuu.com/features/articles): Extend content reach with article-based distribution and measurable engagement.
- [Social Posts](https://issuu.com/features/social-posts): Promote publications through social content designed to increase traffic and readership.

## Integrations
- [Canva](https://issuu.com/integrations/canva): Publish Canva designs to Issuu for interactive distribution and sharing.
- [Adobe InDesign](https://issuu.com/integrations/indesign): Export and publish InDesign documents to Issuu workflows.
- [HubSpot](https://issuu.com/integrations/hubspot): Connect Issuu content with HubSpot for lead generation and marketing automation.
- [Mailchimp](https://issuu.com/integrations/mailchimp): Use Issuu content in email marketing workflows with Mailchimp integration.
- [Dropbox](https://issuu.com/integrations/dropbox): Import documents from Dropbox into Issuu publishing workflows.
- [Google Drive](https://issuu.com/integrations/google-drive): Access and publish files stored in Google Drive.

## Industry Solutions
- [Art, Architecture, and Design](https://issuu.com/industry/art-and-design): Industry-specific use cases for visual portfolios, lookbooks, and design publications.
- [Business](https://issuu.com/industry/business): Publishing workflows and content distribution for business documents and reports.
- [Education](https://issuu.com/industry/education): Digital publishing use cases for schools, institutions, and educational materials.
- [Fashion](https://issuu.com/industry/fashion): Solutions for lookbooks, catalogs, and branded fashion storytelling.
- [Food and Drink](https://issuu.com/industry/food-and-drink): Use cases for menus, magazines, and culinary brand content.
- [Health and Fitness](https://issuu.com/industry/health-and-fitness): Digital publishing examples for wellness, fitness, and health-related content.
- [Real Estate](https://issuu.com/industry/real-estate): Property brochures and marketing materials published as interactive documents.
- [Travel](https://issuu.com/industry/travel): Interactive travel guides, brochures, and destination marketing publications.
